OUR ADVISORY PRACTICES

Risk & Business Advisory

Strengthening governance, managing risks and improving business performance through effective controls and processes.

  • Internal Audit & Risk Assessment
  • Internal Financial Controls (IFC) & Risk Management
  • System Design, Development & SOP Documentation
  • Business Process Reviews & Reengineering
  • Forensic Audit & Investigations
  • ERP / SAP Advisory & Implementation Support
  • Governance, Training & Capability Building

Government & Infrastructure Advisory

Supporting infrastructure and industrial projects through financial modelling, project appraisal and investment evaluation.

  • Infrastructure Project Planning & Appraisal
  • Detailed Project Reports (DPR)
  • Project Financial Modelling & Projections
  • Financial Feasibility & Viability Assessment
  • CAPEX Evaluation & Project Cost Analysis
  • Bank Appraisals & Financing Documentation

WHY CHOOSE SAVITUR?

Professional Expertise. Practical Insights. Meaningful Outcomes.

We combine professional knowledge, business understanding and a hands-on approach to deliver advisory solutions that create lasting value.

1. Professional & Multidisciplinary Expertise

Led by Chartered Accountant expertise and supported by a multidisciplinary team with diverse professional and industry experience.

2. Business-Centric Approach

We look beyond financial statements and compliance requirements to understand business operations, identify risks and address the challenges that affect performance.

3. Insight-Driven Solutions

Our recommendations are supported by structured analysis, professional judgement and a clear understanding of business objectives.

4. System Development, Implementation & Capability Building

Where systems and processes are missing, we help design and establish them. We go beyond recommendations by supporting implementation, training teams and strengthening organisational capabilities for sustainable improvements.

5. Commitment to Excellence

We strive to deliver consistent quality and maintain professional standards.
